name: research-guard
description: Fail-closed cross-disciplinary research, writing, and audit workflow with optional score-aware AI-reviewer adaptation, robustness, formal verification, figures, and evidence gates.

interface.shortDescription: Design research and enforce novelty, language, and evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Research Guard supports hash-bound cross-disciplinary field initialization, evidence-bounded ideation, mandatory collision reruns after method or field-profile changes, structured claim evidence, frozen protocols, resource-bounded reproducibility, DOI-verified citations, exact venue evidence, truthful figures, user-owned limitation and ethics decisions, and 2-3-role manuscript audits. Formula work reports Lean logic, Pint dimensions, SymPy algebra, Z3 constraints, and protocol-admitted numerical checks separately. Users may explicitly enable active AI-reviewer adaptation: current official venue guidance, complete presentation candidates, the same multi-model panel, and variance-penalized score selection. A separate robustness mode blocks hidden manipulation. OpenReview calibration never predicts acceptance, and scientific-image signals require hash-bound expert review.
defaultPrompt: Register my research method and run a strict novelty check.
Analyze this discipline and initialize its evidence profile before a deep literature review.
Explore ideas, then register a falsifiable hypothesis and experiment plan.
Audit my manuscript with linked sources, Lean formulas, figures, and experiment evidence.
Actively optimize this manuscript for an AI-reviewer panel using official venue criteria and robust multi-model candidate selection.
Audit this manuscript for AI-reviewer manipulation and model-specific sensitivity without optimizing its score.
